items.summary_en: Schelten is a tiny village in the Bernese Jura with only 34 people. The village approved the Juso inheritance tax initiative with 55 percent of the votes. It often votes differently from the rest of Switzerland. Village councilor Hans-Ruedi Roth explains why.
